Metadata.description: Malaïka Services supports businesses in the DRC with recruitment, staff placement and secondment, personnel administration and payroll, plus coworking, private offices and business domiciliation.

hero.title: Simplify your human resources and focus on your business.
hero.description: Malaïka Services puts its expertise in recruitment, human resources and staff placement at the service of businesses, so they can build, manage and grow high-performing teams with confidence.
hero.primary_cta: Tell us about your HR need
hero.art_label: Illustration: a network connecting businesses and talent

intro.title: Recruiting, contracts, payroll, declarations: we take it from here.
intro.description: Recruiting, drawing up contracts, running payroll and keeping up with social obligations take time, method and the right skills. Malaïka Services offers businesses flexible support to outsource some or all of these functions.
intro.description_2: From analysing the need to following up with employees, we favour an accessible relationship, clear procedures and transparent information, so every client can move forward with better visibility.
intro.image_alt: A team in a working meeting

hr.title: An HR solution that fits your organisation
hr.description: One-off recruitment, placement or secondment of staff, outsourcing of certain administrative and social functions: we analyse your need and propose the right scope of work.
hr.link: See our HR services in detail

spaces.title: Spaces and support to get you set up
spaces.description: Coworking, equipped offices, domiciliation, a meeting room and administrative support: complementary services to back your organisation and growth.

HrServices.intro: Every business needs reliable employees and well-managed personnel administration. Not every business has the time, tools or a structured HR department to handle each step. Malaïka Services analyses the need and proposes a suitable scope of work.
HrServices.scope_note: Responsibilities, deliverables, timelines and contractual terms are agreed with the client before the assignment begins.

recruitment.title: Recruitment
recruitment.summary: We clarify the role, source candidates, run a structured pre-selection and present the applications that match your expectations.
recruitment.body_1: When you need to fill a position without the time, internal resources or visibility to do it, we support you at every stage of recruitment. We clarify the role and selection criteria, source candidates, run a structured pre-selection and present the applications that match your expectations.
recruitment.body_2: In a one-off recruitment, the selected candidate is hired directly by your company. Our involvement gives you a better-organised process, more targeted applications and more time to focus on the final decision.
recruitment.cta: Trust us with your next hire

placement.title: Placement and secondment
placement.summary: Strengthen your teams or outsource the management of some employees, with one named contact for administrative follow-up.
placement.body_1: To strengthen your teams or outsource the management of certain employees, we offer placement and secondment solutions framed around your needs. Once we have agreed the terms of the assignment with you, we source or mobilise candidates, organise the selection and manage the employees concerned within the agreed scope.
placement.body_2: You get a solution suited to your organisation and a named contact for the administrative follow-up of placed or seconded staff.
placement.cta: Let’s discuss the right formula for your workforce

administration.title: Personnel administration
administration.summary: Preparing and tracking contracts, keeping personnel files and handling the administrative steps included in the assignment.
administration.body_1: Managing contracts, personnel files and administrative obligations can take up a lot of your team’s time. We help you prepare and track contracts, keep the necessary records and handle the administrative procedures included in the scope of our assignment.
administration.body_2: Our work helps improve file tracking, clarify responsibilities and reduce the risk of omissions or errors. When a situation calls for specific expertise, we bring in qualified consultants.

payroll.title: Payroll and social declarations
payroll.summary: Preparing payroll inputs, checking calculations and supporting you with social declarations and contributions.
payroll.body_1: Calculating pay, deductions and social contributions requires precision, regularity and a firm grasp of the applicable obligations. Depending on the agreed assignment, we prepare payroll inputs, check the calculations and support you in preparing social declarations and contributions.
payroll.body_2: The required information, responsibilities, approvals and supporting documents are agreed with you from the start. This makes payroll clearer and helps you keep track of social deadlines, provided the necessary data is supplied completely and accurately.
payroll.cta: Let’s talk about how your payroll is organised

training.title: Training and talent preparation
training.summary: Programmes to prepare young graduates for the realities of the job market. Currently in development.
training.body_1: We believe every talent deserves the chance to reveal their potential and enter the working world with confidence. That is why we want to support candidates, especially young graduates, in gaining the practical skills, professional attitudes and bearings they need to meet the realities of the job market.
training.body_2: Our ambition is to gradually build training programmes rooted in the concrete needs of businesses, while developing a pool of prepared, motivated candidates able to integrate lastingly into their workplace. As these programmes are still in development, their content, format and launch date will be announced once they officially start.

Process.title: Your journey in five steps
Process.description: A clear approach, from the first conversation to the follow-up of the assignment.

1.title: Understanding the need
1.description: We discuss the role, the headcount involved, the skills you are looking for, the context, the constraints and the expected responsibilities.

2.title: Defining the solution
2.description: We propose a scope of work: one-off recruitment, placement or secondment, personnel administration, payroll, or a combination of several services.

3.title: Sourcing or mobilising candidates
3.description: Depending on the assignment, we source applications, activate available candidates or prepare what is needed for administrative outsourcing.

4.title: Selection and contracting
4.description: Candidates are assessed against the agreed criteria. The type of engagement, responsibilities and applicable terms are then formalised by the parties concerned.

5.title: Placement, management or follow-up
5.description: The candidate is hired by the client or managed under the chosen placement or secondment formula. Malaïka Services provides the follow-up set out in the assignment.

Spaces.title: Workspaces and business support
Spaces.description: Complementary services to help you set up, meet and move your paperwork forward.
Spaces.availability: Plans, prices and availability on request.

coworking.title: Coworking
coworking.description: Work in a shared professional space suited to entrepreneurs, consultants and small teams. Depending on the plan, access can include a workstation, an internet connection, a break area and some administrative services.

private_office.title: Equipped private offices
private_office.description: Equipped private offices give you a professional workplace without immediately taking on the full set-up of a permanent office.

domiciliation.title: Business domiciliation
domiciliation.description: A registered business address made available under contractually defined terms. Depending on the plan, the service can include receiving mail and notifying you when it arrives.

room_rental.title: Room rental
room_rental.description: An equipped room for your meetings, training sessions and other professional gatherings.

admin_facilitation.title: Administrative facilitation
admin_facilitation.description: We help businesses identify the procedures, contacts and documents needed for certain administrative, tax or company-formation files. This makes official procedures easier to prepare and follow; it does not replace the competent authority or any required authorisation.

tax.title: Tax support and specialist referral
tax.description: Our experience in accounting and tax allows us to provide support within the agreed scope. When a question requires regulated or specialist expertise, we refer the file or work alongside qualified consultants. Malaïka Services is neither a law firm nor a tax authority.

Spaces.visit_description: Book a visit or ask for the terms for coworking, private offices, room rental and domiciliation.

Audiences.title: Who we work with
Audiences.description: From large organisations to young graduates, the same commitment to clarity.

large.title: Large companies
large.description: We support organisations that want to outsource recruitment, placement, secondment or the administrative follow-up of part of their workforce, within a clearly defined scope.

sme.title: Small and medium-sized businesses
sme.description: A flexible solution for businesses with a few employees and no structured HR department. Support can cover a specific hire, payroll, contracts or several administrative functions.

banks.title: Banks and retailers
banks.description: We look at recurring or one-off needs, notably for cashier, reception and administrative support profiles.

telecom.title: Telecommunications
telecom.description: We analyse the recruitment, placement and administrative support needs of telecom companies, based on the roles, volumes and timelines you share.

graduates.title: Young graduates and candidates
graduates.description: We connect businesses with candidates prepared for professional realities. You can apply for the opportunities currently available.

About.title: Who we are
About.lead: A partner specialised in recruitment, staff placement and human resources outsourcing.
About.description_1: We help businesses build and manage teams suited to their needs, with rigour, proximity and transparency.
About.description_2: Our expertise also covers payroll, personnel administration and administrative and tax support. Through our complementary coworking, domiciliation and workspace services, we offer businesses structured support for their organisation and growth.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: To help businesses recruit, administer and support their employees with more simplicity, compliance and transparency, while letting them stay focused on their core business.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.description: To become, within the next five to ten years, a benchmark for human resources outsourcing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, then gradually build accessible bridges between training young talent and the needs of businesses.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: We explain the service, the responsibilities and the contractual terms in plain language. Where the formula allows, salaries, charges and management fees are shown separately, with the supporting documents available.

listening.title: Listening
listening.description: Every engagement starts with understanding the client’s need, context and constraints. This guides us towards a suitable solution rather than a standard answer.

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.description: We stay accessible to businesses and candidates throughout the key stages of the assignment. A good relationship helps prevent misunderstandings and makes follow-up easier.

rigor.title: Rigour
rigor.description: We rely on defined steps, tools and internal templates to organise recruitment and administrative follow-up. Specialist matters are directed to qualified consultants when needed.

adaptability.title: Adaptability
adaptability.description: One-off recruitment, placement, secondment or administrative outsourcing: the formula is set according to the company’s situation and the agreed scope.

transparent.title: Transparent information
transparent.description: The service, responsibilities and management terms are clearly explained. Financial items are broken down according to the applicable formula, and available supporting documents are shared within the agreed framework.

tailored.title: Solutions that fit the need
tailored.description: Support can cover a one-off assignment or the outsourcing of several functions. The scope is defined around the client’s organisation.

close.title: A contact close at hand
close.description: We prioritise listening, accessibility and follow-up with clients and with the employees concerned.

skills.title: Complementary skills
skills.description: Experience in payroll, accounting, tax and administration rounds out our HR work. Specialist topics can be handled by or referred to qualified consultants.

procedures.title: Procedures you can follow
procedures.description: Recruitment and administrative follow-up rely on defined steps, tools and internal templates. The exact terms are adapted and shared for each assignment.

human.title: A human approach
human.description: Beyond files and calculations, every assignment is about people and an organisation. We make sure expectations are clear and keep a useful dialogue going between the parties.

Cta.title: Let’s talk about your need
Cta.description: Looking for an employee, want to outsource part of your HR, or need better administrative follow-up for your staff? Tell us about your context and we’ll identify the most suitable formula.
